about: Lays its children out along one direction, a semantic gap apart.

alignment.about: Where the children sit across the flow. A column stretches them until a caller picks a place, so `align` is what stops a short child filling the width.
alignment.title: Alignment

directions.about: Which way the children run. A row centres its children across the flow and a column stretches them, so a row of a mark and a word states no alignment.
directions.title: Directions

distribution.about: How the room left over along the flow is shared, in a row that fills its cell.
distribution.title: Distribution

gaps.about: Every gap of the scale, from the tightest a stack offers to the widest.
gaps.title: Gaps

name: Name
title: Stack

wrap.about: A row that wraps folds what will not fit onto the next line. One that does not overflows its cell.
wrap.title: Wrap
